files.name: motion-prompt-060.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Segmented control" (セグメントコントロール), one of the names in "UI component names".
Motion Prompt #060

What it is: A row of joined buttons that switches the view
What the sample shows: Clicking Day, Week or Month slides a blue highlight across and the bar chart below changes height.
Spec:
- 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A grey 300×40 base (radius 10) at (121, 12), split into three 100-wide segments: Day, Week, Month (in Japanese).
- Selection: blue 92×32, radius 8, shadow blur 6; the selected label is white.
- The cursor clicks Week at 1.0 s, Month at 2.1 s and Day at 3.3 s; the selection slides over 0.25 s each with easeInOutCubic.
- Chart below: seven bars 34 wide, 58 px apart (the sixth is blue). Heights move between three data sets (about 30–85, 40–100, 60–115) together with the selection, eased the same way.
When to use it: Use it to switch between two to four views of the same content, such as day, week and month.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/060.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/ui.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
